note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1: "If Single-Active redundancy mode is desired, then the "Single-Active" bit in the flags of the ESI Label extended community MUST be set to 1" Same producer changes as RFC7432-8.2.1-4: a4fe1b70f3 moved generic attribute encoding out of parseConfigRoute, which still validates the merged extended communities against the redundancy mode, and 238bdb62e9 renamed parseESIString in l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams. Single-Active flag-1 assertions unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 0411b53e91). RFC 7432 Section 8.2.1: "If Single-Active redundancy mode is desired, then the "Single-Active" bit in the flags of the ESI Label extended community MUST be set to 1 and the ESI label SHOULD be set to a valid MPLS label value." Only the MUST is the row. Stale only because 0411b53e91 replaced the redundancy-mode argument with a routeIntent struct (redundancyMode plus overlayIndex) through parseL2VPNArgs, l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams, parseConfigRoute and EncodeRoute; the new overlay-index guard refuses only a named selector on a non-ip-prefix route and never touches the Ethernet A-D path. The tagged test units did not change. Fresh overlay mutants (tags ze_core ze_bgp): parseConfigRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch; EncodeRoute passing an intent without the mode reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused; l2vpnRouteToEVPNParams dropping intent.redundancyMode reddens both; parseL2VPNArgs mapping single-active to all-active reddens TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeAccepted, TestOriginPerESRedundancyModeRefused and TestConfiguredEVPNRefusesPerESRedundancyMismatch. The message-package tests (TestRFC7432ESILabelRedundancyAccepted/Refused) are untouched by the change. Earlier open item unchanged: the config-path positive is only the untagged test/encode/evpn-per-es-redundancy-mode.ci, and the bgp-evpn-gobgp interop still owes its red proof.
